en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European valley town surrounded by low wooded hills and patchwork fields. In the foreground are steep‑roofed houses typical of Central Europe, with a mixture of farm buildings and villas. In the middle distance an industrial complex with tall chimneys emits smoke next to a railway line and small station or freight yard with several sidings. Further back the town spreads along the valley floor, with scattered church towers and farmsteads on the opposite slope. No visible printed caption or border text appears on the image side.
